description: The owner hears about what the agent did on its own: a request waiting for an ok, a reminder when it keeps waiting, a flow that broke. Code decides what and when; a channel plugin sends it (email over Resend today)
client_copy: Te avisa por mail cuando algo espera tu ok o cuando algo no salió.
_comment: SYSTEM, BECAUSE AN AGENT THAT WORKS ON ITS OWN AND NEVER SAYS SO is the
failure both test clients named first. Nobody buys this; everybody has it.
IT REQUIRES NO PLUGIN. What it reads -- `approvals`, `events` -- are the
engine's own tables (`engine/core/db.py`), so an agent without `approval`
still hears about a broken flow.
NO KEY, NO CHANNEL, NOT AN ERROR. Without RESEND_API_KEY the email channel
is not registered, the manifest's `notify_channels` is empty and the portal
offers nothing: the lab's state until there is an account.
